get.description: Machine credentials do not see emergency-locked workspaces; account sessions can list them.
get.summary: List organisations the caller belongs to

post.summary: Create an organisation and become its owner

delete.description: Requires confirmation and no unresolved leases; deletes the workspace and its dependent records.

parameters.description: Required confirmation: true, 1 or yes, case insensitive.
parameters.name: confirm

get.description: Requires an ow_session browser cookie backed by an account session and organisation membership. Authorization headers are rejected; bearerAuth is not accepted by this handler.

403.description: Not a browser session or organisation member

put.description: Requires an actual workspace owner using an ow_session browser cookie. Authorization headers are rejected. Locking revokes non-owner sessions and OAuth credentials and halts automation in the workspace; restoring does not unlock a locked application.

delete.description: Available when built with LDAP support. Deleting the configuration also removes directory bindings.

get.description: Available when built with LDAP support. Bind password is not returned.

put.description: Available when built with LDAP support. Partial update; initial setup requires ldaps:// url, bind_dn, bind_password and base_dn. Empty password preserves the stored password. user_filter must contain {username}; group_roles uses semicolon-separated Group=role pairs. Only owners may map admin-capable roles. Changing URL removes directory bindings.

post.description: The last owner must transfer ownership first. Removes the caller from workspace teams.
Only an owner may grant roles with admin rights. Defaults to developer. Existing accounts are added directly; new accounts receive a single-use invite token valid seven days.
post.summary: Add a member or issue an invitation (org:admin)

delete.description: Cannot remove yourself or the last owner. Only an owner can remove an owner.

patch.description: Only an owner may grant admin rights or change an owner. Cannot demote the last owner.

post.description: Name must be nonempty and cannot shadow owner, admin or developer. Permissions default to [] and are stored without shape validation.

put.description: Requires an allowed http(s) URL. Omitted or empty secret preserves the stored secret.

Requires idp_entity_id and metadata_xml or metadata_url. Fetches metadata only when XML is empty, applies egress checks and validates the IdP metadata. Omitted trust and provisioning fields reset to their defaults.

Omitted fields are preserved. Changing issuer without a new secret drops the stored secret. An explicitly empty oidc_client_secret clears it only with clear_oidc_client_secret=true. IP ranges and domain lists are comma separated; webhook egress is guarded.

post.summary: Add an organisation member to a team (org:admin)

delete.description: Returns success even if the team or membership does not exist; deletion is constrained to this organisation.

post.description: Target must be another active, verified member. The caller becomes admin.
